title: On a wide touch tablet the card opens expanded with its buttons showing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on a touch tablet with no mouse, held so its screen is at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: an iPad Pro 12.9-inch in landscape.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the work order card as it first opens, without tapping anything.
  2. Look at the Sales Representative field and the space to its right, without tapping them.
  3. Tap the + button and tap "Sales Representative - Parts".
  4. Look at the two fields and the space to the right of "Sales Representative - Parts", without tapping them.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the card is not collapsed: Lead Technician, Service Advisor and the Sales Representative field show without tapping the card's edit button.
  • Step 2: the field shows its dropdown arrow and the + button shows beside it at its full size, without any hover.
  • Step 3: the menu closes and "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" show, in that order.
  • Step 4: both fields show their dropdown arrow, and the remove x shows beside "Sales Representative - Parts", without any hover.

Chris Ward's answer 10 chose option (a) of the question sheet: on a wide touch screen with no mouse the card opens expanded, with the + and remove x always shown. Touch decides the buttons; the screen width decides whether the card is collapsed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R2: “The + and remove x buttons are always shown, at the same 32px size (S2-R1, S2-R8), and work as on a desktop (Story 2).”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”
  • S2-R5: “Picking "Sales Representative - Parts" closes the menu and replaces the one field with two fields, in this order: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts".”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (19 Oct 2026), read 20 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 10: “10. (a) as the tech plan: touch decides the buttons, screen width decides whether the card is collapsed.”
